host: macOS arm64, Homebrew PostgreSQL 17 binaries, debug builds of oo and oo-docs-engine

notes.files: 20 Markdown, 1 golden docx, 1 golden pdf; the first BRIEF waits for all 22 to publish
notes.install_cold_note: uv pip install --no-cache --no-deps of the 84 versions pinned in requirements.lock plus opencv-python-headless 5.0.0.93, 1.2 GB venv, from the Aliyun PyPI mirror. The default PyPI index ran at about 100 KB/s here (torch alone had not finished after 35 minutes, run abandoned), so the cold number depends on the mirror and the network, not on uv
notes.install_warm_offline_seconds: 2.3 (uv --offline from the uv cache, plus 367 MB of model files copied from the local oo-docs-parser:dev image)
notes.models: copied from /opt/models of the local oo-docs-parser:dev image; huggingface.co is not reachable from this host (SSL error), so the real model download was not measured
notes.parse_time: all_published minus serve_up is 33 s: the two Office files, one fresh worker process each (spawn start method, torch import per request), with debug builds
notes.forkserver: the sidecar default start method (forkserver) died with signal 11 on the pdf on macOS arm64; OO_PARSER_START_METHOD=spawn works and is what the script sets
notes.opencv: the PyPI opencv wheel bundles FFmpeg (D65): a development stand-in only
